Apache-2.0.text_class: canonical license body; no package-specific copyright line
Apache-2.0.completeness: full canonical marker set plus all 11 structural markers (header, sections 1-3/8/9, END OF TERMS, APPENDIX template); LF-only
Apache-2.0.closure_rule: closes only rows whose own manifest declares Apache-2.0 (or an SPDX expression containing that token); MIT/ISC rows never close from promotion because they need the package's own copyright line
